review_note: Primary institutional sources confirm the core claims. UNEP states that exceedance of 1.5°C is now widely assessed as unavoidable under current policies and that a 1.8°C peak is the best-case scenario described. WMO separately confirms a 91% probability of at least one temporary exceedance during 2026-2030 and stresses that Paris Agreement thresholds concern long-term warming, not a single year. Certification remains pending human editorial approval.
